note: The character-discovered charcoal Map (docs/design/PLAYER_CARTOGRAPHY_MAP_DESIGN.md; WP-MAP, GOALS-REPAIR). Each character keeps a sparse record of the map cells (cell_m a side) it has actually surveyed, in blocks of block_cells x block_cells. Walking survey_step_m from the last survey point surveys every cell within survey_radius_m of the character (never in a cave). A cell keeps what was seen there (ground height, water, trees) and q, the character's Mapping skill when it was seen. The sketch's accuracy comes from q, never from today's skill, so a skill gain alone redraws nothing: a cell is seen again at the higher skill only when the character comes back and their Mapping is at least improve_min_levels above its q. Mapping practice comes only from new cells: one practice for every cells_per_practice cells never seen before (no practice for standing still, opening the map, or walking over known ground). Height is sent rounded to a step that runs from height_step_coarse_m at Mapping 1 to height_step_fine_m at Mapping 100; trees are sent as there or not below tree_detail_from and as a density 0..3 from it. Blocks go to their own character only: all of them on joining (send_per_pass a pass), then each block that changes, at most every resend_s. A connection's first position, a move longer than jump_steps survey steps or one faster than max_speed_mps (a respawn, a teleport, a claimed dash) surveys nothing until the character walks on from there; new cells bank at most bank_practices practices. Saved per character in maps/ in the server store. ALL NUMBERS ARE PROVISIONAL (GOALS-REPAIR A-5, Map constants): engineering defaults for Dave to tune in play.

From Tracking trails_tracking (10, Dave 23 Nov 2026: "tracking trails at 10 is fine. till then we will learn to see them by eye") the Map draws the game trails of every trail block this character has been near (kept in its map record, protocol 152), as a thin dashed line, only inside the cells it has surveyed.
landmarks_note: Dave 23 Nov 2026 play test: the map "needs to show the important stuff": water's edges, the ocean, rivers, roads and pathways, campfires, cave entrances, bog iron, fruit trees, good fishing spots, a goblin clan's face with its name, a rock with resources started and left (gone when finally broken), "anything a human would find of interest". Each survey looks round marks_radius_m (server_map.gd look_round, terrain_server _map_landmarks) and puts what it sees on this character's map, in its surveyed cells only; what is no longer there leaves the marks within that radius. One mark stands for its kind within merge_m for merge_kinds (a stand of fruit trees, a bog iron field), within point_merge_m for one thing in one place (a fire, a cave, a rock). A blow on a rock looks again within look_now_m at once. fishing_good catches by this character in one fishing_cell_m square mark a good fishing spot, which stays. fruit_trees: flora species -> [group]; fruit_groups: group -> [one tree, several, many (from orchard_from trees seen together; "" never)]. Numbers PROVISIONAL (coordinator, for Dave's review).
